card.name: Partway through longer words
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle or end of a longer word, most clearly the ending of "Coadministration" in drug-interaction text. It also fires on single words like "deliberate", "humans", "seized" and "discontinued" after a short opening word.

modes.label: Coadministration ending
modes.description: The last piece of "Coadministration" in drug interaction lists.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Drug Interactions Coadmin<<istration>> of a number of CYP3A

modes.label: Other mid-sentence words
modes.description: A single word after a short lead-in, such as an adjective or a passive verb.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE Acute<< deliberate>> overdosage in man has not occurred

card.plain: It lights up on the ending of "Coadministration" and on a scattering of other words partway through phrases.
